req.title: Emit OpenAPI schema
req.statement: The system shall serve an OpenAPI 3.x JSON specification at GET /openapi.json.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-019 requires GET /openapi.json to return HTTP 2xx with a valid OpenAPI 3.x JSON payload. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — happy path returns 200 with correct content-type and OpenAPI structure including exact title/version from app config; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST) returns 405 Method Not Allowed; (3) boundary BVA — response body is valid JSON and contains the mandatory 'openapi' version key starting with '3.', plus exact path entries for known endpoints. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant-mutation, operator-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

tests.name: test_get_openapi_json_returns_200_with_valid_schema
expected: JSON contains key 'openapi' with value starting with '3.'
JSON contains key 'info' with title 'Task Manager API' and version '1.0.0'
trace: R-TASK-019: system shall serve OpenAPI 3.x JSON at GET /openapi.json
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx with expected payload
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_openapi_json_returns_200_with_valid_schema():
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
    assert "application/json" in ct
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, dict)
    assert "openapi" in body
    assert body["openapi"].startswith("3.")
    assert "info" in body
    assert body["info"]["title"] == "Task Manager API"
    assert body["info"]["version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert "paths" in body
    assert isinstance(body["paths"], dict)

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_openapi_json_paths_contain_required_endpoints():
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    paths = body["paths"]
    assert "/" in paths
    assert "get" in paths["/"]
    assert "/tasks/" in paths
    assert "get" in paths["/tasks/"]
    assert "post" in paths["/tasks/"]
    assert "/tasks/{task_id}" in paths
    assert "get" in paths["/tasks/{task_id}"]
    assert "put" in paths["/tasks/{task_id}"]
    assert "delete" in paths["/tasks/{task_id}"]

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_openapi_json_schema_components_define_task():
    r = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert "components" in body
    assert "schemas" in body["components"]
    schemas = body["components"]["schemas"]
    assert "Task" in schemas
    task_schema = schemas["Task"]
    assert "properties" in task_schema
    props = task_schema["properties"]
    assert "id" in props
    assert "title" in props
    assert "completed" in props
    assert "created_at" in props

tests.name: test_openapi_json_response_is_idempotent
expected: Both response bodies are identical dicts
openapi version field is identical in both calls
trace: R-TASK-019: deterministic/idempotent requirement — same spec served on every call
BVA: boundary between first and subsequent calls must yield identical output
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

def test_openapi_json_response_is_idempotent():
    r1 = client.get("/openapi.json")
    r2 = client.get("/openapi.json")
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    body1 = r1.json()
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert body1["openapi"] == body2["openapi"]
    assert body1["info"]["title"] == body2["info"]["title"]
    assert body1["info"]["version"] == body2["info"]["version"]
    assert set(body1["paths"].keys()) == set(body2["paths"].keys())
